title: Smoky Ethiopian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy lamb kebab recipe with a smoky twist, inspired by traditional Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoky, kissed, and ethiopian.
Add the lamb cubes and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto skewers.
Brush the dabo with coconut oil and place on the grill.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
